simplified.benefits: Free secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across 29,000+ empanelled public and private hospitals across India.
simplified.eligibility: BPL families, SECC 2011 database beneficiaries, white card holders.
simplified.steps: Visit any empanelled hospital with Aadhaar card or Ration card to verify eligibility with Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra (PMAM).

telugu.eligibility: BPL families, SECC 2011 database beneficiaries, white card holders.
telugu.steps: Visit any empanelled hospital with Aadhaar card or Ration card to verify eligibility with Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra (PMAM).

simplified.benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) cash incentive paid in installments directly to bank account upon registering pregnancy and child immunization.
simplified.eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first and second live child (if second child is a girl).
simplified.steps: Apply at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or Village Health Sub-Centre with Aadhaar card, MCP Card, and Bank Account details.

simplified.benefits: Free essential drugs, 50+ free diagnostic blood & urine tests, dial-a-doctor tele-consultation.
simplified.eligibility: Open to all citizens visiting Government Primary Health Centres (PHCs) and Area Hospitals.
simplified.steps: Walk in to any Government Hospital or Primary Health Centre (PHC). No income certificate required.

Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana (TB Financial & N.scheme_name: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana (TB Financial & Nutritional Support)
Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana (TB Financial & N.telugu_name: నిక్షయ్ పోషణ్ యోజన (టీబీ రోగుల పోషకాహార సహాయం)

simplified.benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹500 transferred directly to patient bank accounts for nutritional support.
simplified.eligibility: All notified Tuberculosis (TB) patients undergoing anti-TB treatment in public or private sector.
simplified.steps: Register at nearest Government Health Centre or DOTS provider with Aadhaar card and bank passbook.
